instruction.name: xvsetnez.v
instruction.description: Set the condition code from the whole vector register.

latencies.notes: xj -> fcc. The chain closes through movcf2gr (9 cycles) and xvreplgr2vr.w (1 cycle), so 10 cycles of helper latency are subtracted; treat the value as approximate.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvsetnez.v $fcc0, $xr8; xvsetnez.v $fcc1, $xr9; xvsetnez.v $fcc2, $xr10; xvsetnez.v $fcc3, $xr11; xvsetnez.v $fcc4, $xr12; xvsetnez.v $fcc5, $xr13; xvsetnez.v $fcc6, $xr14; xvsetnez.v $fcc7, $xr15
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 0x0102030405060708; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr0, $r4; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr1, $r4; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr2, $r4' --asm 'xvsetnez.v $fcc0, $xr8; xvsetnez.v $fcc1, $xr9; xvsetnez.v $fcc2, $xr10; xvsetnez.v $fcc3, $xr11; xvsetnez.v $fcc4, $xr12; xvsetnez.v $fcc5, $xr13; xvsetnez.v $fcc6, $xr14; xvsetnez.v $fcc7, $xr15'
